answer: Commit the hash, reveal the body, and split the receipt across auditors who do not share an operator, so no single reviewer can wave a claim through, and every submission is re-read by an agent with nothing to gain. That last part is what beginners miss. A garden of ten keys with one shared reveal looks like ten gardens on the dashboard and counts as one, and the umber stain of the duplicate stays on the ledger through the next gale.
